summary_en: DMS approved the acquisition of up to 150,000 shares (2.76% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥500 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 28, 2026 and March 31, 2027, as part of capital allocation strategy balancing growth investment and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 27, 2026, DMS's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied mutatis mutandis through Article 165, paragraph 3. The company will purchase up to 150,000 ordinary shares (2.76% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total of ¥500 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from October 28, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The buyback forms part of the company's capital allocation strategy announced on March 18, 2025 in its update on "Initiatives toward Management Focused on Cost of Capital and Stock Price." DMS aims to balance growth investments with enhanced shareholder returns to increase corporate value. The company has set a dividend policy targeting ROE of 8% during the fiscal year ended March 2025 through the fiscal year ending March 2027, while treasury stock acquisitions are to be considered based on the status of growth investments and other factors.

The Board determined that the acquisition is appropriate after comprehensively considering the second-quarter FY2027 results and forward guidance, the current stock price level, and progress on initiatives to realize capital-conscious and stock price-conscious management.
